protocol: Phase 5: Pre-Declared Fixes and Improvement Round (Post-hoc, Exploratory)

rules.R1: Every variant declared first; none added, dropped or retuned after seeing results; report all, including failures.
rules.R2: Rules derive from STIX properties and task text only, never from ground truth or per-query results.
rules.R3: Label everything 'post-hoc round 2, exploratory'; cti-taa was already seen.
rules.R4: No causal words (due to, attributable to, confirms, severely, actual cause, true expected center).
rules.R5: Attribution tables report object-level AND text-inclusive credit; assert exactly one STIX group per cti-taa GT and list 0/>1 matches.

query_hygiene.split_query_rule: instruction = text before marker ('Threat Report:' or '**Text:**'); body = text after marker
query_hygiene.assertion: Marker must be present in all 339 benchmark queries (cti-ate: 60, CTI-ATTACK: 229, cti-taa: 50)

V0h.name: V0h
V0h.description: Body-only query without entity expansion (the fair baseline).

V1h.name: V1h
V1h.description: High-precision alias expansion on query body.

Vrel.name: Vrel
Vrel.seed_entities: Software (malware and tools) detected in query body under V1h filtering criteria
Vrel.scoring_formula: score(group) = sum_{s in detected_software} 1 / |{g in groups : g uses s}|
Vrel.expansion_tokens: Canonical name and first alias of top 3 scoring groups

domain_filtering.cti-ate: Restricted to Enterprise or Mobile based on instruction text marker ('MITRE Enterprise' vs 'MITRE Mobile')

o2_clean_comparisons.primary_metric: Mean Recall@B over binding budgets in {500, 1000, 2000, 4000}
o2_clean_comparisons.secondary_reporting: Full 4-budget scaling curves; E0' HD vs E0' raw (hygiene effect alone)

generation_ablation.hybrid_prompt_verbatim: Use the provided context if it is relevant; otherwise use your own knowledge. List MITRE technique IDs.
generation_ablation.hybrid_prompt_cti_taa_verbatim: Use the provided context if it is relevant; otherwise use your own knowledge. Attribute to a threat group.
generation_ablation.execution_condition: Run strictly after completion of the 47 pending E1b-MIXED calls on CTI-ATTACK
